name: Vortex Oscillator System
summary: This EA uses the Vortex Indicator (VI+ and VI-) to identify trend direction and generate buy/sell signals based on crossovers of the positive and negative vortex lines. It enters long positions when VI+ crosses above VI- and short positions when VI- crosses above VI+, applying configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The system is a classic trend-following approach that capitalizes on sustained directional moves in the market.
summary_zh: 该EA使用涡旋指标（VI+和VI-）来识别趋势方向，并根据正负涡旋线的交叉产生买入/卖出信号。当VI+上穿VI-时做多，当VI-上穿VI+时做空，并设置可配置的止损和止盈水平。该系统是一种经典的趋势跟踪方法，旨在捕捉市场中的持续方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于涡旋指标（Vortex Indicator），该指标由Botes和Siepman开发，通过计算正向运动（VM+）和负向运动（VM-）与真实波幅（TR）的比值来衡量趋势方向。入场条件为VI+上穿VI-时开多单，VI-上穿VI+时开空单，属于典型的趋势跟踪交叉策略。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈水平，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏马丁格尔或网格机制，但也没有实现基于风险的仓位计算，风险控制完全依赖静态止损止盈参数。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Vortex Indicator, developed by Botes and Siepman, which measures trend direction by calculating the ratio of positive movement (VM+) and negative movement (VM-) to true range (TR). Entry conditions trigger a long position when VI+ crosses above VI- and a short position when VI- crosses above VI+, constituting a classic trend-following crossover strategy. Exit conditions rely on predefined fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and positions may also be closed when an opposing crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management lacks Martingale or grid mechanisms, but also does not implement risk-based position calculation, with risk control entirely dependent on static stop loss and take profit parameters. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护，适合初学者使用
涡旋指标对趋势起始阶段敏感，能够较早捕捉趋势转向
采用固定止损止盈，每笔交易风险可控，不会出现无限亏损
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and maintain, suitable for beginners
Vortex Indicator is sensitive to trend initiation phases, capable of capturing trend reversals early
Uses fixed stop loss and take profit, risk per trade is controllable without unlimited loss exposure
cons: 在震荡行情中涡旋指标频繁交叉，会产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户资金比例，无法根据风险动态调整仓位大小
缺乏市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率过滤），无法区分趋势市和震荡市
止损止盈为固定点数而非基于ATR动态计算，在不同波动率环境下适应性差
cons_en: Frequent crossovers in ranging markets generate numerous false signals leading to consecutive losses
Fixed lot position sizing does not account for account equity ratio, unable to dynamically adjust based on risk
Lacks market regime filter (such as ADX or volatility filter), cannot distinguish trending from ranging markets
Stop loss and take profit use fixed pips instead of ATR-based dynamic calculation, poorly adaptable across different volatility environments
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中抑制交易信号，减少虚假入场
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和风险比例仓位计算，提高对不同市场环境的适应性
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to suppress trading signals in ranging markets and reduce false entries
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and risk-proportional position sizing to improve adaptability across different market conditions

risk_points: 缺乏市场状态过滤，在震荡市中可能连续亏损
固定点数止损止盈在高波动率市场可能过小导致频繁止损
risk_points_en: Lacks market regime filter, may suffer consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed pip stop loss/take profit may be too tight in high volatility markets causing frequent stop outs
